identity.title: [v0.92.1][WP-01] Open the v0.92.1 milestone and create the execution wave

values.summary: Opened the v0.92.1 execution wave with exactly 45 new issue contracts and reconciled the 10 existing milestone issues without duplicate creation.
actual_changes: Created the exact ordered 45-child v0.92.1 issue wave from CORP-A through TAIL-10 using deterministic operation keys and typed GitHub issue mutations.
Reconciled and verified existing issues #51, #84, #122, #251, #261-#264, #342, and #345 against their canonical milestone routing.
Retained per-operation intent, request, observed readback, partial recovery, live census, and final creation receipts.
Changed read-only GitHub observation from GraphQL issue view to REST and added bounded retries for transient TLS read failures; mutation retries remain controlled by durable operation receipts.

actual_validation.purpose: Validated all 45 ordered live child issues, all 10 existing reconciliations, routing, operation receipts, and final receipt integrity.
Rejected malformed diff and whitespace errors in the WP-01 candidate.
